description: Score a single skill against the gardener rubric. Reads the skill's SKILL.md, references/, and templates/, then writes a 7-dimension scorecard with per-criterion rationales and a recommended-actions list. Isolated counterpart to /gardener: same rubric, one item at a time. Use when the user asks to audit a skill, score a skill, check if a skill is healthy, or wants to re-score after making changes.
